page_title: ANG 2-1 STR | Angers v Strasbourg 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Clement Turpin is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' It's a yellow card for Ousmane Camara (Angers).
90+2' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Valentin Barco is replaced by Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg).
90+2' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Andrey Santos (Strasbourg), whose header goes wide of the goal.
90+1' Lanroy Machine comes onto the pitch because Farid El Melali (Angers) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
86' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Himad Abdelli will be replaced by Enzo Caumont (Angers).
85' Oscar Perea (Strasbourg) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Oscar Perea (Strasbourg) coming on for Samuel Amo-Ameyaw.
83' Today's referee Clement Turpin rightly decides to book Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) for his harsh tackle.
80' The game is interrupted as Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) is flagged offside.
79' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
75' Substitution. Jim Allevinah leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jacques Ekomie (Angers).
75' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Zinedine Ould Khaled (Angers) replacing Marius Courcoul.
75' A substitution has been made. Lilian Raolisoa is replaced by Farid El Melali (Angers).
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
72' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
69' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
65' A substitution has been made. Guela Doue goes off and Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) comes on.
61' Jordan Lefort (Angers) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Clement Turpin didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
60' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
59' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
59' Now Angers have a corner.
57' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
56' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' Flag goes up against Himad Abdelli (Angers) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Angers.
53' Angers failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' Himad Abdelli (Angers) unleashes a shot, but it just misses the right-hand post.
50' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) races onto a pass and smashes in a shot at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post.

48' 2 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Lilian Raolisoa sends a cross in and Esteban Lepaul (Angers) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes into the bottom left corner and the score changes to 2:1.
47' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul. Angers win a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Diego Moreira will not participate anymore and Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Clement Turpin shows the yellow card to Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) for a heavy challenge.
45' Florent Hanin (Angers) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
43' 1 - 1 Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Yahia Fofana with a strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
42' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
38' Strasbourg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. It will be a corner kick for Strasbourg.

37' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
32' Angers couldn't find the way to score from a close-range free kick as Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
30' A decent effort by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
29' Dangerous play by Jim Allevinah (Angers). Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Strasbourg.
28' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Yahia Fofana stops the ball from going inside right post.
27' The corner from Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) is hurriedly cleared.
23' Himad Abdelli (Angers) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Clement Turpin no option but to blow his whistle.
21' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
20' Flag up against Esteban Lepaul (Angers). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
15' 1 - 0 Esteban Lepaul (Angers) gets in a good position after an exceptional individual run and releases a powerful shot that flies precisely into the bottom left corner.
14' A pass from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is intercepted by Yahia Fofana and the move breaks down.
10' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
9' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
9' The Strasbourg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' Carlens Arcus (Angers) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
5' Angers control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has started.
Strasbourg will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Clement Turpin.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
